## Purpose

Keep seed stock available for the planting season without overstocking.

## Scope

All seed lines sold in the Fernhill shops. See also [Receiving deliveries](WI-001-receiving-deliveries.md).

## Roles

| Role | Responsibility | Decides |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Head of Purchasing | Owns the process and approves orders | Order volume |
| Shop manager | Reports stock levels weekly | Nothing on volume |

## Steps

1. The shop manager reports stock levels each Monday.
2. The Head of Purchasing reviews the report and approves the order.
3. Purchasing places the order and records the handover to the warehouse.

- Seasonal lines are ordered in January.
- Perennial lines are ordered on demand.
